biological_replicate: three biological replicates were performed for each line
WT was used as a control and three biological replicates were performed for each line.
experimental_design: Here, using in vivo interaction proteomics, two HAKAI-interacting zinc finger proteins, HIZ1 and HIZ2, are discovered as components of the Arabidopsis m6A writer complex.
number_of_biological_replicates: WT was used as a control and three biological replicates were performed for each line.
number_of_fractions: After running samples on SDS-PAGE gel, the gel for the same lane was cut into five slices.
technology_type: LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer
Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin and then analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
